title: Do Language Models Know When They’ll Refuse? Probing Introspective Awareness of Safety Boundaries
reasoning: The paper evaluates the introspective awareness (metacognition) of LLMs regarding their own safety boundaries and refusal behaviors. While the study uses safety categories such as 'hate speech' and 'discrimination,' it focuses on the model's ability to self-predict its behavior rather than evaluating religious beliefs, moral judgment, or specific ethical frameworks like deontology or utilitarianism.
